title: Approve the homepage composition
question: Same clean Pixieset-level look, three ways to open the page. Pick the one to build (you can say what to borrow from the others in the steer box).

options.label: A · Split: headline + product
options.thesis: Headline and actions on the left, the real product (laptop gallery + phone password screen) on the right.
options.viewport: Left: headline, one line, two buttons. Right: laptop client gallery overlapped by a phone password screen. Three feature cards below.
options.risk: The most familiar SaaS layout; photos are small inside the mockups.

options.label: B · Image-led: full-bleed photo
options.thesis: One big editorial photograph owns the first screen; a floating card shows the proof of views and downloads.
options.viewport: Full-bleed Cairo rooftop wedding photo, white headline bottom-left with two buttons, activity card bottom-right.
options.risk: Depends on one excellent photo; less of the product visible above the fold.

options.label: C · Centered: dashboard showcase
options.thesis: Centered headline, then a wide screenshot of the photographer dashboard full of real-looking galleries.
options.viewport: Pill label, centered headline and buttons, wide browser window showing the galleries grid with status and counts.
options.risk: Speaks to photographers' workflow more than to the emotion of the photos.
